title: Samsung Dryer dE Error Code — Door Error
description: dE indicates that the dryer is not detecting the door as properly closed. A blocked latch, misalignment, wiring fault, or failed door switch can trigger the code.
root_cause: The control depends on the door-switch circuit to confirm that the door is closed before operation. If the expected switch state is not detected, the dryer prevents or interrupts operation and reports dE.
diagnostic_steps: Open and close the dryer door firmly and check for clothing caught in the seal.
Inspect the latch and strike for damage or misalignment.
With power disconnected, inspect the door-switch wiring and connector.
Test the door switch for proper continuity and replace it if it fails.

title: Samsung Dryer HC Error Code — High Temperature Heating Check
description: HC indicates a high-temperature heating condition. Restricted airflow, a defective thermistor, heating-system fault, or another condition causing excessive heat can trigger the code.
root_cause: The control monitors temperature through the dryer thermistor and compares the measured value with expected operating limits. Excessive temperature or an abnormal sensor signal causes the heating fault.
diagnostic_steps: Clean the lint filter and inspect the entire exhaust path for restrictions.
Check the exterior vent hood and flexible duct for crushed or blocked sections.
Disconnect power and inspect the thermistor wiring.
If airflow is good, test the thermistor and heating components against the model's specifications.

title: Maytag Washer F5E2 Error Code — Lid Lock Problem
description: F5E2 indicates that the washer is having difficulty locking or confirming the lid-lock position. Obstructions, misalignment, wiring faults, or a failed lid-lock assembly can cause the code.
root_cause: The control requires confirmation from the lid-lock circuit before continuing certain portions of the wash cycle. If the lock does not reach or maintain the expected state, the control records F5E2.
diagnostic_steps: Remove any clothing or objects interfering with the lid.
Close the lid firmly and inspect the strike and lock opening for damage.
Disconnect power and inspect the lid-lock connector and harness.
If the mechanism does not reliably lock or unlock, test or replace the lid-lock assembly.

title: Maytag Washer F5E3 Error Code — Lid Unlock Problem
description: F5E3 indicates that the washer has detected a lid-lock or lid-unlock fault. A jammed mechanism, damaged strike, wiring issue, or failed lock assembly can cause the condition.
root_cause: The control monitors the lid-lock position switch and expects the mechanism to move to the commanded state. Failure to reach that state within the expected period generates the error.
diagnostic_steps: Stop the cycle and allow the basket to come to a complete stop.
Inspect the lid area and lock for clothing, debris, or mechanical damage.
Disconnect power and inspect the lock wiring and connector.
If the lock repeatedly fails to unlock, test or replace the lid-lock assembly.

title: Maytag Washer F9E1 Error Code — Long Drain
description: F9E1 means the washer is taking too long to drain. A restricted drain hose, blocked pump, or failing drain pump is a common cause.
root_cause: The control monitors the water-level response during the drain stage and expects the tub to empty within a defined time. If the level does not decrease sufficiently, F9E1 is recorded.
diagnostic_steps: Inspect the drain hose for kinks, restrictions, or incorrect installation.
Check the household drain or standpipe for blockage.
Inspect the drain pump area for debris and confirm the impeller can move.
If the drain path is clear and the pump does not drain correctly, test or replace the pump.

title: Maytag Dryer F01 Error Code — Primary Control Failure
description: F01 on applicable Maytag dryers indicates a primary electronic control fault. Power surges, damaged electronic components, or control-board communication problems can cause the error.
root_cause: The main control is unable to complete its internal electronic functions or communicate correctly with the dryer system. The exact failure mechanism depends on the control-board design and model.
diagnostic_steps: Disconnect the dryer from power for at least five minutes.
Restore power and verify whether the code returns immediately.
Inspect visible harness connectors for loose connections or damage.
If F01 returns, identify the exact model and match the control board to its model-specific parts diagram.
